title: SIMPLEX: composition-space deep learning for bio-inspired hydrogel adhesion with prospective validation on model-discovered formulations and interpretable composition rules
summary: 316 internal formulations plus a 25-formulation Bayesian-optimization-acquired batch; grouped 10-seed/5-fold internal evaluation and same-protocol external batch, with measured hydrogel adhesion; source describes prospective model-selected formulations and composition analysis.
